classification_policy.source: Persisted supplier_decisions rows created by src.scoring
classification_policy.Insufficient Evidence: overall confidence is Low (Sparse Data) OR delivery_sample_count < 5 OR quality_sample_count < 5
classification_policy.At Risk: delivery_sample_count >= 5 AND delivery_score < 75 OR quality_sample_count >= 5 AND quality_score < 90
classification_policy.Reliable: minimum evidence is met, no dimension guardrail is breached, and final_score >= 80
classification_policy.Watch: minimum evidence is met, no dimension guardrail is breached, and final_score < 80
classification_policy.policy_note: Minimum evidence and dimension guardrails are fixed domain rules, not thresholds optimized against the reported evaluation set.
